items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I called her and told her that I was really surprised and that I had no idea she could play like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, she sent me a writeup not too long ago from San Francisco, and she sent me a tape, I've got to be honest with you, you know -- I was really pleasantly

surprised, because I had no idea that she really played the way she does. You know, she sounds really good; she knows what she is doing, and I called her and told her that I was really surprised and that I had no idea she could play like that. But she can play.
What -- does she appear in San Francisco?
